response.evidence: The Quick start section presents a tabbed block (npm, pnpm, Yarn) under the sentence "To get started developing your component quickly, you can use a template already set up for you." Each tab holds the same command for a different package manager, e.g. "npm create astro@latest my-new-component-directory -- --template component", "pnpm create astro@latest my-new-component-directory -- --template component" and "yarn create astro my-new-component-directory --template component".
response.rationale: The three commands are in mutually exclusive tabs. Each creates the same component template in the same directory, differing only in package manager syntax. The page never states outright that they are alternatives, but the tab layout and identical arguments show you run only the one that matches your package manager.
